row.evidence: SentinelOne's pricing page lists Singularity Core, Control, Complete ($179.99/yr per endpoint), Commercial ($229.99) and Enterprise (Contact Sales) with no mention of SSO or SCIM, and no public SentinelOne page documenting SCIM was found.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to unknown: June's 'SCIM gated to Singularity Enterprise' and the ~$12-16/endpoint Enterprise estimate have no first-party source and are dropped. Okta's OIN page for SentinelOne marks SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Schema Discovery, Entitlement Management) as supported, so SCIM provisioning via Okta appears to exist, but no plan is stated anywhere public. SentinelOne's admin/API documentation is hosted inside the Management Console. Pricing is per endpoint (not per user) and sold through partners: Core $69.99, Control $79.99, Complete $179.99, Commercial $229.99 per endpoint annually (5-100 workstations), Enterprise Contact Sales; per-user fields left null.

plans.name: Singularity Core
plans.notes: Per endpoint; price only in the comparison-table data.

scim.notes: Only Okta's OIN page indicates SCIM; no SentinelOne SCIM documentation is public.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Schema Discovery, Entitlement Management and Workflows Connectors as checked; Deactivate is not checked. Builder not stated.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn SaaS-app tutorial found (sentinelone-tutorial and sentinelone-provisioning-tutorial return 404).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud guide covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.notes: API documentation is served from the customer Management Console (e.g. usea1-partners.sentinelone.net/api-doc), a login-gated JS app; support and community KBs are portal-based.

searched: https://www.sentinelone.com/sitemap-index.xml (all sub-sitemaps: scim, sso, saml, okta, entra, provision, api)
open_questions: Which Singularity package (if any) includes SAML SSO and SCIM is not stated publicly.
Whether the Okta SCIM connector is SentinelOne-built and whether it supports deactivation is unclear.
User-management API, audit-log API and their plans are documented only inside the console.
Google Workspace and OneLogin catalogue apps not checked.
